entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: An alliance of magic-users, historians, intellectuals and artificers from across Terisiare that sought neutrality in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: Conflict between Urza and Mishra in which the Third Path sought neutrality.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City where the Third Path gathered; it fell after a siege.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: School whose Archmandrite invited the first members.

entities.name: Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower
entities.description: Invited the first members of the Third Path; fate unknown.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Of the College of Lat-Nam; survived the fall of Terisia and helped found the City of Shadows.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Of the College of Lat-Nam, first member.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Scholar from the Ronom Glacier who fled Terisia City with the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Archaeologist from Penregon who carried the Golgothian Sylex out of Terisia City.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: Artifact carried out of Terisia City by Feldon and Loran.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Co-founder of a hidden school of magic in 80 AR.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Co-founder of a hidden school of magic in 80 AR.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Hidden school of magic that took in hunted spellcasters.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: Academy founded by Drafna in the Lat-Nam strait.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church that shunned magic and artifice, forcing spellcasters into hiding.

entities.name: Fall of Terisia City
entities.description: Siege and fall of the city in which the Third Path suffered heavy losses.

events.summary: The Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invites the first members of the Third Path.
events.quote: As its first members, the Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invited the Abbot from the Brotherhood of Gix

events.summary: Third Path studies lead to the foundation of the modern schools of Magic and the use of colored mana on Terisiare.
events.quote: their studies led to the foundation of the modern schools of Magic and the use of colored mana on Terisiare

events.summary: Terisia City falls after a siege; Feldon and Loran flee with the Golgothian Sylex.
events.quote: The Third Path suffered heavy losses during the Fall of Terisia City

events.summary: The Third Path scatters across the lands after the fall.
events.quote: After Terisia's fall, the members of the Third Path scattered across the lands.

events.summary: After the Sylex Blast and the rise of the Church of Tal, remaining members go underground.
events.quote: forcing any remaining members of the Third Path to go underground

events.summary: Drafna founds the City of Shadows; Ashnod and Tawnos found a hidden school that becomes the Conclave of Mages.
events.quote: A hidden school of magic had been founded there by Ashnod and Tawnos in 80 AR
